meta.note: Agent-visible material only. The orchestrator must not show 'id', 'family' or 'pair' to the model; the model sees only the system prompt, first_user, tool_schemas and observations. Tool outputs are in export_hidden_outputs.json, which must only be read by code and never placed in model context.
meta.loss_rows: verdict index 0..2 then escalate; columns true state
meta.warning_sentence: Warning: repeated or agreeing reports from tools that read the same data source are not independent confirmations.
meta.observation:
After a valid call of tool j (its c-th call, 0-based), the observation text is json.dumps({'tool': name, 'result': {arg: subject, field: outputs[name][c]}, 'cost': cost, 'budget_remaining': B}) with Python json.dumps separators (', ', ': '); if B < min cost append '
Budget exhausted: only submit is possible now.'; in K4 append '
' + grouped view: 'Evidence so far, grouped by data source:' then one line per data source in tool order, '- <source> [<tool names>]: <name=value, ...>' or '(none)'; in K4c append '
' + 'Evidence so far, in the order received:' then '- call <n>: <name>=<value>' per call. In the text protocol observations are sent as user messages prefixed 'Observation: '. Invalid actions return json.dumps({'error': reason, 'message': ..., 'budget_remaining': B}). Use step.py for a reference implementation.
meta.episodes_without_submit: flagged no_submit; scored with the worst verdict at the final belief

episodes.subject: checkout-api
episodes.first_user: Ticket 40232: determine the current status of service `checkout-api`. Budget: 6 cost units.

function.name: health_check
function.description: Returns the latest recorded health status of a service. Output field `status` in {'ok', 'degraded', 'down'}. Cost: 1. Served from read replica metrics-cache-eu1. Replica staleness incidents: about 38% of sessions; a stale replica keeps returning 'ok' (about 97% of calls). Accuracy when the replica is fresh: 0.88 per call, errors spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: status_dashboard
function.description: Reads the availability panel of the ops status dashboard for a service (green = healthy, amber = degraded, red = down). Output field `panel_state` in {'green', 'amber', 'red'}. Cost: 2. Served from statusdb-primary (primary database, never stale). Accuracy: 0.71 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: log_search
function.description: Samples the last 5 minutes of application logs and summarises them (no_anomalies = healthy, elevated_error_rate = degraded, connection_refused_storm = down). Output field `summary` in {'no_anomalies', 'elevated_error_rate', 'connection_refused_storm'}. Cost: 1. Queries logstore-eu1 directly on every call (never stale). Accuracy: 0.68 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: synthetic_probe
function.description: Runs an end-to-end synthetic transaction against the live service (pass = healthy, slow = degraded, fail = down). Output field `result` in {'pass', 'slow', 'fail'}. Cost: 4. Queries the live service endpoint directly on every call (never stale). Accuracy: 0.91 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: submit
function.description: Submit the final verdict. Ends the session.

function.name: broker_dashboard
function.description: Reads the queue gauge of the broker dashboard (green = draining, amber = backlogged, red = stalled). Output field `gauge` in {'green', 'amber', 'red'}. Cost: 2. Served from broker-admin-primary (primary database, never stale). Accuracy: 0.72 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: consumer_log_scan
function.description: Samples the consumers' logs and summarises them (acks_normal = draining, acks_slow = backlogged, no_acks = stalled). Output field `summary` in {'acks_normal', 'acks_slow', 'no_acks'}. Cost: 1. Queries consumer-log-store directly on every call (never stale). Accuracy: 0.71 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: canary_message
function.description: Publishes a canary message to the live broker and waits for it (consumed = draining, delayed = backlogged, not_consumed = stalled). Output field `result` in {'consumed', 'delayed', 'not_consumed'}. Cost: 4. Queries the live broker directly on every call (never stale). Accuracy: 0.91 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: submit

Output field `summary` in {'applied_promptly', 'apply_backlog', 'apply_halted'}. Cost: 1. Queries binlog-archive directly on every call (never stale). Accuracy: 0.74 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: checksum_compare
function.description: Compares row checksums between the replica and its primary (match = in_sync, behind = lagging, diverged = broken). Output field `result` in {'match', 'behind', 'diverged'}. Cost: 4. Queries the replica and its primary directly on every call (never stale). Accuracy: 0.86 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: submit
function.description: Submit the final verdict. Ends the session.

Replica staleness incidents: none (replica verified fresh for this session). Accuracy when the replica is fresh: 0.87 per call, errors spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: backup_console
function.description: Reads the backup console indicator for a database (green = verified, yellow = incomplete, red = corrupt). Output field `indicator` in {'green', 'yellow', 'red'}. Cost: 1. Served from read replica backup-catalog-cache. Replica staleness incidents: none (replica verified fresh for this session). Accuracy when the replica is fresh: 0.85 per call, errors spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: agent_log_scan
function.description: Samples the backup agent's logs and summarises them (no_errors = verified, skipped_files = incomplete, checksum_errors = corrupt). Output field `summary` in {'no_errors', 'skipped_files', 'checksum_errors'}. Cost: 2. Queries backup-agent-logs directly on every call (never stale). Accuracy: 0.69 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: restore_test
function.description: Restores a sample of the backup on a scratch host (restore_ok = verified, restore_partial = incomplete, restore_failed = corrupt). Output field `result` in {'restore_ok', 'restore_partial', 'restore_failed'}. Cost: 4. Queries a scratch restore host directly on every call (never stale). Accuracy: 0.86 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: submit
function.description: Submit the final verdict. Ends the session.

function.description: Returns the latest recorded resolution status of a domain. Output field `status` in {'resolving', 'intermittent', 'failing'}. Cost: 1. function.name: network_dashboard
function.description: Reads the DNS tile of the network dashboard for a domain (green = resolving, amber = intermittent, red = failing). Output field `tile` in {'green', 'amber', 'red'}. Cost: 1. Served from read replica resolver-cache-ap1. Replica staleness incidents: none (replica verified fresh for this session). Accuracy when the replica is fresh: 0.88 per call, errors spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: query_log_sample
function.description: Samples the last 5 minutes of resolver query logs and summarises them (all_noerror = resolving, some_servfail = intermittent, mostly_servfail = failing). Output field `summary` in {'all_noerror', 'some_servfail', 'mostly_servfail'}. Cost: 2. Queries query-log-store directly on every call (never stale). Accuracy: 0.69 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: dig_probe
function.description: Queries the authoritative name servers directly from several vantage points (answer = resolving, timeout_some = intermittent, no_answer = failing). Output field `result` in {'answer', 'timeout_some', 'no_answer'}. Cost: 4. Queries the authoritative name servers directly on every call (never stale). Accuracy: 0.90 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

Cost: 1. Served from read replica metrics-cache-eu1. Replica staleness incidents: none (replica verified fresh for this session). Accuracy when the replica is fresh: 0.87 per call, errors spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: log_search
function.description: Samples the last 5 minutes of application logs and summarises them (no_anomalies = healthy, elevated_error_rate = degraded, connection_refused_storm = down). Output field `summary` in {'no_anomalies', 'elevated_error_rate', 'connection_refused_storm'}. Cost: 2. Queries logstore-eu1 directly on every call (never stale). Accuracy: 0.68 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: synthetic_probe
function.description: Runs an end-to-end synthetic transaction against the live service (pass = healthy, slow = degraded, fail = down). Output field `result` in {'pass', 'slow', 'fail'}. Cost: 4. Queries the live service endpoint directly on every call (never stale). Accuracy: 0.85 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: submit
function.description: Submit the final verdict. Ends the session.

Prior (before any tool call), from historical tickets: verified 0.76, incomplete 0.16, corrupt 0.08. The true status does not change during this session.

Score = total tool cost + loss of the final verdict (lower is better):
- correct verdict: 0
- declaring "verified" when the backup is actually incomplete or corrupt (a restore would fail): 60
- any other wrong verdict: 20
- escalate (hand over to a human): 8
Tool costs: backup_status 1, backup_console 1, agent_log_scan 2, restore_test 4. Budget: 6 cost units in total; a call you cannot afford is rejected.

Tools:
- backup_status(database): Returns the recorded state of the latest backup. Output field `state` in {'verified', 'incomplete', 'corrupt'}. Cost: 1. Served from read replica backup-catalog-cache. Replica staleness incidents: about 26% of sessions; a stale replica keeps returning 'verified' (about 97% of calls). Accuracy when the replica is fresh: 0.94 per call, errors spread evenly over the other two values.
- backup_console(database): Reads the backup console indicator for a database (green = verified, yellow = incomplete, red = corrupt). Output field `indicator` in {'green', 'yellow', 'red'}. Cost: 1. Served from read replica backup-catalog-cache. Replica staleness incidents: about 26% of sessions; a stale replica keeps returning 'green' (about 97% of calls). Accuracy when the replica is fresh: 0.80 per call, errors spread evenly over the other two values.
- agent_log_scan(database): Samples the backup agent's logs and summarises them (no_errors = verified, skipped_files = incomplete, checksum_errors = corrupt). Output field `summary` in {'no_errors', 'skipped_files', 'checksum_errors'}. Cost: 2. Queries backup-agent-logs directly on every call (never stale). Accuracy: 0.69 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.
- restore_test(database): Restores a sample of the backup on a scratch host (restore_ok = verified, restore_partial = incomplete, restore_failed = corrupt). Output field `result` in {'restore_ok', 'restore_partial', 'restore_failed'}. Cost: 4. Queries a scratch restore host directly on every call (never stale). Accuracy: 0.91 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

Observation model (exact):
- backup_status and backup_console both read the replica backup-catalog-cache. With probability 0.26 this replica is stale for the WHOLE session. Staleness is shared by both tools and persists across retries.
  While it is stale, EVERY call to either tool reports verified with probability 0.97 (each other status 0.015), whatever the true status.
  While it is fresh, each call is correct with the accuracy below and otherwise reports one of the two other statuses at random, independently across calls.
- backup_status: accuracy when the replica is fresh 0.94.
- backup_console: accuracy when the replica is fresh 0.80.
- agent_log_scan reads backup-agent-logs, which is never stale: every call is correct with probability 0.69, errors independent across calls.
- restore_test reads a scratch restore host, which is never stale: every call is correct with probability 0.91, errors independent across calls.
- The true status does not change during the session. Distinct data sources fail independently.

Each turn, you may reason briefly, then end your reply with exactly one JSON object on its own line:
{"action": "call", "tool": "<tool name>"}  or  {"action": "submit", "verdict": "<one of: verified, incomplete, corrupt, escalate>"}

Output field `summary` in {'no_errors', 'skipped_files', 'checksum_errors'}. Cost: 1. Queries backup-agent-logs directly on every call (never stale). Accuracy: 0.78 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: restore_test
function.description: Restores a sample of the backup on a scratch host (restore_ok = verified, restore_partial = incomplete, restore_failed = corrupt). Output field `result` in {'restore_ok', 'restore_partial', 'restore_failed'}. Cost: 4. Queries a scratch restore host directly on every call (never stale). Accuracy: 0.91 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: submit
function.description: Submit the final verdict. Ends the session.

Prior (before any tool call), from historical tickets: verified 0.56, incomplete 0.34, corrupt 0.10. The true status does not change during this session.

Score = total tool cost + loss of the final verdict (lower is better):
- correct verdict: 0
- declaring "verified" when the backup is actually incomplete or corrupt (a restore would fail): 60
- any other wrong verdict: 20
- escalate (hand over to a human): 8

- backup_status(database): Returns the recorded state of the latest backup. Output field `state` in {'verified', 'incomplete', 'corrupt'}. Cost: 1. Served from read replica backup-catalog-cache. Accuracy when the replica is fresh: 0.94 per call, errors spread evenly over the other two values.
- backup_console(database): Reads the backup console indicator for a database (green = verified, yellow = incomplete, red = corrupt). Output field `indicator` in {'green', 'yellow', 'red'}. Cost: 1. Accuracy: 0.78 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.
- restore_test(database): Restores a sample of the backup on a scratch host (restore_ok = verified, restore_partial = incomplete, restore_failed = corrupt). function.description: Returns the recorded final state of a job run. Output field `state` in {'succeeded', 'partial', 'failed'}. Cost: 1. Served from read replica scheduler-cache-us2. Replica staleness incidents: about 31% of sessions; a stale replica keeps returning 'succeeded' (about 97% of calls). Accuracy when the replica is fresh: 0.86 per call, errors spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: pipeline_dashboard
function.description: Reads the run badge of the pipeline dashboard for a job (green = succeeded, amber = partial, red = failed). Output field `badge` in {'green', 'amber', 'red'}. Cost: 1. Served from read replica scheduler-cache-us2. Replica staleness incidents: about 31% of sessions; a stale replica keeps returning 'green' (about 97% of calls). Accuracy when the replica is fresh: 0.86 per call, errors spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: run_log_grep
function.description: Samples the job's run logs and summarises them (clean = succeeded, row_rejects = partial, fatal_errors = failed). Output field `summary` in {'clean', 'row_rejects', 'fatal_errors'}. Cost: 1. Queries runlog-archive directly on every call (never stale). Accuracy: 0.72 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: validate_output
function.description: Runs a row-count validation query against the warehouse output tables (rows_complete = succeeded, rows_missing = partial, table_empty = failed). Output field `result` in {'rows_complete', 'rows_missing', 'table_empty'}. Cost: 4. Queries the warehouse tables directly on every call (never stale). Accuracy: 0.90 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

function.description: Returns the recorded final state of a job run. Output field `state` in {'succeeded', 'partial', 'failed'}. Cost: 1. Served from read replica scheduler-cache-us2. Replica staleness incidents: about 28% of sessions; a stale replica keeps returning 'succeeded' (about 97% of calls). Accuracy when the replica is fresh: 0.90 per call, errors spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: pipeline_dashboard
function.description: Reads the run badge of the pipeline dashboard for a job (green = succeeded, amber = partial, red = failed). Output field `badge` in {'green', 'amber', 'red'}. Cost: 1. Served from read replica scheduler-cache-us2. Replica staleness incidents: about 28% of sessions; a stale replica keeps returning 'green' (about 97% of calls). Accuracy when the replica is fresh: 0.82 per call, errors spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: run_log_grep
function.description: Samples the job's run logs and summarises them (clean = succeeded, row_rejects = partial, fatal_errors = failed). Output field `summary` in {'clean', 'row_rejects', 'fatal_errors'}. Cost: 1. Queries runlog-archive directly on every call (never stale). Accuracy: 0.74 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: validate_output
function.description: Runs a row-count validation query against the warehouse output tables (rows_complete = succeeded, rows_missing = partial, table_empty = failed). Output field `result` in {'rows_complete', 'rows_missing', 'table_empty'}. Cost: 4. Queries the warehouse tables directly on every call (never stale). Accuracy: 0.87 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

Output field `summary` in {'no_anomalies', 'elevated_error_rate', 'connection_refused_storm'}. Cost: 2. Queries logstore-eu1 directly on every call (never stale). Accuracy: 0.74 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: synthetic_probe
function.description: Runs an end-to-end synthetic transaction against the live service (pass = healthy, slow = degraded, fail = down). Output field `result` in {'pass', 'slow', 'fail'}. Cost: 4. Queries the live service endpoint directly on every call (never stale). Accuracy: 0.92 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

Output field `summary` in {'all_noerror', 'some_servfail', 'mostly_servfail'}. Cost: 2. Queries query-log-store directly on every call (never stale). Accuracy: 0.72 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: dig_probe
function.description: Queries the authoritative name servers directly from several vantage points (answer = resolving, timeout_some = intermittent, no_answer = failing). Output field `result` in {'answer', 'timeout_some', 'no_answer'}. Cost: 4. Queries the authoritative name servers directly on every call (never stale). Accuracy: 0.88 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

Replica staleness incidents: about 32% of sessions; a stale replica keeps returning the value frozen when it stopped refreshing (about 97% of calls; the frozen value is 'in_sync' in about 80% of incidents). Accuracy when the replica is fresh: 0.92 per call, errors spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: db_dashboard
function.description: Reads the replication light of the database dashboard (green = in_sync, amber = lagging, red = broken). Output field `light` in {'green', 'amber', 'red'}. Cost: 1. Served from read replica monitoring-cache-eu3. Replica staleness incidents: about 32% of sessions; a stale replica keeps returning the value frozen when it stopped refreshing (about 97% of calls; the frozen value is 'green' in about 80% of incidents). Accuracy when the replica is fresh: 0.87 per call, errors spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: binlog_scan
function.description: Samples the replica's binlog apply records and summarises them (applied_promptly = in_sync, apply_backlog = lagging, apply_halted = broken). Output field `summary` in {'applied_promptly', 'apply_backlog', 'apply_halted'}. Cost: 2. Queries binlog-archive directly on every call (never stale). Accuracy: 0.73 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: checksum_compare
function.description: Compares row checksums between the replica and its primary (match = in_sync, behind = lagging, diverged = broken). Output field `result` in {'match', 'behind', 'diverged'}. Cost: 4. Queries the replica and its primary directly on every call (never stale). Accuracy: 0.87 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: submit
function.description: Submit the final verdict. Ends the session.

Replica staleness incidents: none (replica verified fresh for this session). Accuracy when the replica is fresh: 0.92 per call, errors spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: status_dashboard
function.description: Reads the availability panel of the ops status dashboard for a service (green = healthy, amber = degraded, red = down). Output field `panel_state` in {'green', 'amber', 'red'}. Cost: 2. Served from statusdb-primary (primary database, never stale). Accuracy: 0.80 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: log_search
function.description: Samples the last 5 minutes of application logs and summarises them (no_anomalies = healthy, elevated_error_rate = degraded, connection_refused_storm = down). Output field `summary` in {'no_anomalies', 'elevated_error_rate', 'connection_refused_storm'}. Cost: 1. Queries logstore-eu1 directly on every call (never stale). Accuracy: 0.66 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: synthetic_probe
function.description: Runs an end-to-end synthetic transaction against the live service (pass = healthy, slow = degraded, fail = down). Output field `result` in {'pass', 'slow', 'fail'}. Cost: 4. Queries the live service endpoint directly on every call (never stale). Accuracy: 0.86 per call; errors are independent across calls and spread evenly over the other two values.

function.name: submit
function.description: Submit the final verdict. Ends the session.
